paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token

model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between IDK error rate and IDK recall for four different parameter combinations. The x-axis, labeled “IDK error rate,” is a linear scale ranging from 0.02 to 0.25 with tick intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled “IDK recall,” is a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.65 with tick intervals of 0.05. The first line, represented by blue crosses, corresponds to the “No LFP-reg, fixed λ” parameter combination, starting at a recall value of approximately 0.11 at an error rate of 0.02 and reaching a recall value of approximately 0.60 at an error rate of 0.23.  A second line, depicted by green dashed lines and red triangles, represents the “No LFP-reg, adaptive λ” parameter combination, beginning with a recall of approximately 0.12 at an error rate of 0.02 and ending with a recall of approximately 0.58 at an error rate of 0.23. The third line, represented by orange crosses and line, corresponds to the “With LFP-reg, fixed λ” parameter combination, initiating at a recall of approximately 0.11 at an error rate of 0.02 and culminating in a recall of approximately 0.50 at an error rate of 0.23. Finally, the fourth line, shown by red triangles and dashed lines, signifies the “With LFP-reg, adaptive λ” parameter combination, starting at a recall of approximately 0.12 at an error rate of 0.02 and achieving a recall of approximately 0.56 at an error rate of 0.23.
